name: 01370 · Shelburne Fls, MA
findings: ZIP 01370 (Shelburne Fls) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01370 (Shelburne Fls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01370 (Shelburne Fls) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.8 times the typical level).
